title: MAP-LOC-firstmoss-launch-festival - Firstmoss Launch Festival Location Map

sections.title: Player text
sections.body: The lane opens into a village festival: green lanterns, mossfruit cakes, damp banners, children under watchful eyes, and music doing its best to be louder than the ward's uneven hum.
